items.question: What kinds of information does the UAE Labour Market Observatory provide about the UAE labour market?
items.gold: Periodic data and information on competitiveness indicators of the UAE's labour market, outputs of the policies regulating it, and innovative services, programmes and initiatives.
items.fact: Observatory provides periodic labour market data and competitiveness indicators

items.question: Which groups does the UAE Labour Market Observatory serve as a compass for, in understanding the UAE labour market?
items.gold: All entities, investors, employers, and any interested party.
items.fact: Observatory serves entities, investors, employers, and interested parties
